Ado.//: Real Azure DevOps ingest for the Regression tab (CIRP). Enabled=false keeps the mock provider active. Never put PAT/secret values here; the PAT is read from the ADO_PAT environment variable (SecretEnvVarName is the env-var NAME, not the secret).

Llm.//: LLM-backed code-change summarization (CodeChurn). Off by default. The API key is read from the env var named by ApiKeyEnvVarName (NOT stored here). Endpoint = your Azure OpenAI resource URL; MapModel/ReduceModel = deployment names.

Ado.//Branches: Optional offline fallback only. The switcher is populated live from recent ADO builds (RegressionSourceCatalog.GetBranchesAsync); keep empty so ADO is the source of truth. Any name listed here is injected into the switcher even if it no longer exists in ADO.
Ado.//DefaultBranch: Preselect this branch in the CodeChurn switcher on load. Must match a live branch name; if absent it falls back to (all branches).
Ado.//AuthMode: Interactive = sign in with your AVEVA Microsoft (Entra) account from the Regression tab; the token auto-refreshes so it never needs manual rotation like a PAT. TenantId/ClientId may stay empty to use the well-known Azure CLI public client + your home tenant, or set your org's Entra app registration. Switch to 'Pat' to fall back to the ADO_PAT env var.

Maintenance.//: Fleet-panel revert engine. RevertScriptPath is invoked as 'script.ps1 <vmName> <snapshot>'. Revert-AgentVM.ps1 adapts that to Revert-RcloudMachines.ps1 and reads vCloud creds from the RCLOUD_USER / RCLOUD_PASSWORD env vars (never store secrets here); set RCLOUD_ORG to override the default org 'AppServerPool2'. Adjust the path to wherever the revert scripts are deployed. Empty/missing path now fails cleanly at precheck instead of quarantining the node.

ImpactMapping.//: IndexRoot is where the impact databases live. null = %ProgramData%\TestAgentSolution\ImpactIndex (the durable learning store goes to the sibling \Learning). The IMPACT_INDEX_ROOT environment variable overrides this. Never point it inside the repo: the index is a regenerable cache that reached 1.29 GB and is git-ignored. Provision with deploy\Prepare-ImpactIndexStorage.ps1, populate with deploy\Rebuild-ImpactIndex.ps1.

Persistence.//: Mirrors the DURABLE learning store (impact-outcomes.db) to a share that survives controller VM snapshot reverts, and restores it on startup when the local copy is gone. Snapshots go to <NetworkPath>\<MachineName>\ so hosts never overwrite each other. IncludeIndex is off because the retrieval index is regenerable and can exceed 1 GB - rebuilding is cheaper than transferring it.
Persistence.//MergeAcrossHosts: Folds every host's snapshot into <NetworkPath>\_canonical and pulls the union back down, so each host learns from runs executed on the others. Safe without locking: outcome rows are append-only facts, so this is a set union. Runs are keyed by Guid; MappingSelections/ExecutionOutcomes use autoincrement ids, so they are unioned on (RunId, TestCaseId) instead - a primary-key union would silently discard another host's rows.
Persistence.//HostId: Folder name for this host on the share. Empty = machine name. Set only if two impact hosts run on one machine, so they do not overwrite each other's snapshot.

Controller.//AgentSharedSecret: Shared secret agents must send as the x-agent-token gRPC header (AgentAuthInterceptor). Empty = agent RPCs unauthenticated (fail-open). Prefer the AGENT_SHARED_SECRET env var over storing it here.
